content:
Olivia - Partner Eng: Heads-up — MedCity ran our marketplace image in their legacy k8s (on-prem) and hit a blocker: their security team requires decrypting model keys only via their Azure Managed HSM (no external KMS). marketplace install fails during init with KMS AccessDenied. Can SI + infra triage?
Ravi - SI: Yep, reproducing locally. Install log: 
```
  ERROR: failed to fetch secret: AccessDenied
  at kms.decrypt (kms.go:122)
  Caused by: principal not allowed to unwrapKey on managedHSM
```
Ravi - SI: They also disallow egress except to their internal container registry and Azure endpoints via Private Link. Marketplace flow expects pulling some helper artifacts from redwood-registry.
Diane - Solutions: Thanks — sounds like two constraints: (1) KMS/HSM-only decrypts, (2) outbound network limit. Propose short-run workaround: Dedicated Private deployment (customer VPC), BYOK with AKV Private Endpoint. Long-run: marketplace image attestation + allowlist flow. Want an arch call today.
Sam - Infra: For the Dedicated/Private path we need to confirm required ports and IP ranges for image pulls and health checks. Minimal list: 
```
  - TCP 443 -> registry.redwood.dev (or private mirror)
  - TCP 443 -> telemetry.redwood.dev (opt-in)
  - UDP 123 -> NTP (optional)
```
Sam - Infra: If they block egress entirely, we can mirror images into their internal registry (requires signing/attestation step).
Ravi - SI: Customer will not allow mirrors unless we provide signed images and an attestation report. Also must prove keys never leave HSM. How do we support AKV Managed HSM unwrap with our startup scripts?
Olivia - Partner Eng: Two-pronged: 1) Support BYOK via Azure Key Vault Private Link + Service Principal bound to a single cluster. 2) Add a PKCS#11 shim for workloads so unwrap happens over the Private Link. We're already prototyping a shim for AWS CloudHSM; adapt for AKV. See internal notes: https://go.redwood.dev/marketplace-kms (private).
Tom - Security: Confirming constraints — we can support Azure Managed HSM via Private Endpoint but need documented controls: ACLed service principal, least-privilege role (unwrap only), attestation that key material is HSM-protected (no export). Need customer to share AKV resource ID + allowed principals. Also we require an offline-signed image policy for marketplace bundles that will run in highly restricted environments.
Sam - Infra: I'll open infra ticket to track image-mirroring automation and private registry onboarding. If we go Dedicated Private, we can also host a customer-only artifact mirror in their VPC and configure imagePullSecrets to use their registry credentials.
deploy-bot: Created ticket RW-OPS-6241: "MedCity HSM / Marketplace image mirror onboarding" assigned to infra. ETA 2 business days for initial scoping.
Diane - Solutions: Okay, proposed immediate plan: (A) schedule 30m arch call today — confirm AKV resource id + exact egress allowlist, (B) infra to scope mirror + image signing steps, (C) security to provide required principal/role template and attestation checklist. Ravi — can you collect the customer's AKV resource id and their registry host?
Ravi - SI: On it. I have a meeting with MedCity security at 1500 PT, will bring the ask and return with values.
Olivia - Partner Eng: Great — I'll send a calendar invite for 1530 PT and add meeting notes template. Thanks all :thumbsup:
